title: There is no group edit mode in the Revit API
task: Enter a group's edit mode programmatically, the way the Revit UI's Edit Group does, to change its members in place. No such API exists: there is no Document.EditGroup and nothing like Document.EditFamily for groups.
summary: Stop searching for an edit-group scope. To change what a group contains, ungroup an instance, edit the loose elements, regroup them into a new GroupType, and reassign the other instances (see group-edit-propagates). A member edit without ungrouping is allowed only while exactly one instance is placed, and then only with a warning.

miss.surfaced: no group edit scope member exists to find

pitfalls.symptom: Repeated searches for an EditGroup / group edit scope API return nothing usable.
pitfalls.cause: The public API has no group edit mode. This is a long-standing, documented gap (confirmed against the Revit API forum and the Building Coder blog during the recorded session), not a search miss.
pitfalls.fix: Use the ungroup, edit, regroup, reassign route in group-edit-propagates.
